title: incident-bot: add oncall runbook quicklinks and SLO context enrichment for diagnostics
author: Nisha Patel
release_notes: Adds on-call quicklinks to runbooks and enriches incident diagnostics with correlated SLO context. Improves mean time to diagnosis for common outages.
description:
Motivation: on-call responders often need a quick path from an incident to relevant runbooks and to understand SLO context for the affected service. This PR adds quicklinks to runbooks in incident-bot messages and enriches automated diagnostics with correlated SLO summaries (error budget burn, recent SLI trends, alerting thresholds) so on-call can triage faster.

What changed: consolidated runbook quicklinks component, new SLO context enrichment module, UX improvements to compact runbook cards and link precedence rules. Includes feature flag `runbook_quicklinks_v2` and a tiny persistence change to cache resolved runbook slugs for 6 hours.

Checklist:
- [x] Implementation of runbook quicklinks component
- [x] SLO context enrichment for diagnostics payloads
- [x] Unit tests for enrichment logic and feature flag gating
- [x] Integration tests for message rendering
- [x] E2E smoke tested on staging with Canary channel
- [x] Updated docs and runbook templates

Design notes: The quicklinks UI is intentionally compact to avoid noisy messages. We prioritize the on-call runbook associated with the alerting SLI, then the Service Owner page, then any generic KBs. SLO context is fetched from slo-toolkit service with a capped timeout (300ms) to avoid affecting bot latency; when timeout occurs we fall back to a short SLO summary cached from the last successful fetch.

Rollout plan: behind `runbook_quicklinks_v2` flag. Enable for 10% of incidents for 24h, observe message delivery latency and on-call feedback. Ramp to 100% if no regressions in 48h.

Testing: added unit tests covering API failure modes, timeout fallback, and message rendering under compact mode. Integration tests run against a mocked slo-toolkit with representative SLI histories. Manual verification performed by on-call rotation in staging.

Related: builds on prior incident-bot diagnostic work (see ENG-1723, PR #184999 for compact runbook UX) and ties into slo-toolkit APIs introduced in ENG-2019.
commits_summary:
3 commits: initial runbook quicklinks component + layout (Nisha); add SLO context enrichment and timeout/caching behavior; tests and docs + feature flag gating. Full messages: 
- feat(runbook): compact quicklinks UI and link precedence
- feat(slo): attach correlated SLO summary to diagnostics payload (timeout + cache)
- test/docs: add unit/integration tests and docs for feature flag
review_conversation: Evan Zhang: Nice improvement — can we ensure the slo-toolkit client respects circuit breaker semantics? I saw a small spike when I ran integration tests.
Nisha Patel: Good call, added simple breaker with a 3s backoff and a per-service failure threshold. See enrichment/cache.go for implementation.
Liam O'Connor: UX looks good. Two minor nits: reduce card padding and collapse long runbook titles. Added comments inline.
Nisha Patel: Addressed nits in the second commit, trimmed titles at 80 chars and added ellipses. Updated screenshots in docs.
Sofia Rinaldi: Approving once CI is green. Please add a rollout note to oncall handbook for the 10% canary.
Nisha Patel: Added handbook note and rollout steps to docs/runbooks/quicklinks.md — thanks!
Evan Zhang: LGTM. Approving and will squash-merge once tests finish.
merge_outcome: Merged by Evan Zhang via squash on 2024-11-27. Changelog entry and release notes added. Rollout started at 2024-11-28 behind feature flag at 10%.
notes: Performance: SLO enrichment adds an average of 45ms to diagnostics when slo-toolkit responds; 95th percentile bounded by 300ms timeout. Observability: added metrics incident_bot.slo_enrichment.latency and incident_bot.runbook.quicklinks.render_count. Monitor these during ramp.
testing_instructions: To smoke test locally: set RUNBOOK_QUICKLINKS_V2=true and point INCIDENT_BOT_SLO_TOOLKIT_URL to staging slo-toolkit. Trigger alert payload sample in tests/fixtures/alert_sample.json and verify message contains runbook card and SLO summary. Run `go test ./pkg/incident-bot/...` and `yarn test` for webapp component.
